name: Eagle County Regional Airport

runway.v: one runway, 7-25, 9,000 ft (about 2,743 m) long and 150 ft (about 46 m) wide
runway.quote: Runway 7-25, which is 9,000 feet long by 150 feet wide in an east-west orientation.

handling.v: Signature Aviation is the FBO, on the south side of the airport

customs.v: CBP clears aircraft Thursday to Monday 09:00-17:00 Mountain Time; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; after-hours service only if asked during duty hours; aircraft are cleared plane-side on the Signature ramp; user fee airport (fee charged through the FBO); no commercial cargo; in bad weather divert to Denver International unless another CBP airport is arranged

permits.v: user fee airport for customs: a fee is charged; 3 hours' notice before arrival for all aircraft; customs office inside the Signature Aviation FBO; eAPIS (private) or APIS (charter) needed for all international flights
permits.quote: 3 hours advance notice is required prior to arrival for all aircraft.

fuel.v: 100LL, Jet-A1, Jet A1+, SAF and MoGas (master plan inventory)
fuel.quote: Fuel types available include 100LL, Jet-A1, Jet A1+, SAF, and MoGas.

deicing.v: de-icing for general aviation and airlines on the de-icing pad at the east end of the south apron
deicing.quote: General aviation and commercial aircraft deicing is available on the deicing pad

hours.v: control tower staffed 07:00-19:00 April to November and 07:00-23:00 December to March, per the master plan inventory (data about 2022; confirm before relying on it); airport opening hours are not stated
hours.quote: staffed by Serco-employed controllers from 0700 to 1900, April through November, and 0700 to 2300 from December through March.

noise.v: no noise abatement procedures, mandatory or voluntary, are set at the airport; it encourages voluntary practices such as reduced power on take-off and steeper climbs
noise.quote: No noise abatement procedures (either involuntary or voluntary) have been established at EGE

max_aircraft.v: aircraft heavier than the pavement capacity listed in the FAA directory need the Aviation Director's prior permission; the rules give no figure
max_aircraft.quote: shall land, take off, or taxi at the Airport without prior permission of the Aviation Director
